title: UAE Blames Iran for Drone Attacks on Two ADNOC Tankers in Strait of Hormuz
detail: Two tankers affiliated with Abu Dhabi's state-owned ADNOC were struck by drones while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on the evening of Aug 13, the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs said Aug 14, calling the strikes a 'hostile Iranian attack' and 'acts of piracy' by the IRGC that posed 'a direct threat to the stability of the region, its peoples, and the global energy supply.' UKMTO confirmed both vessels sustained minor damage; no injuries were reported and there was no immediate Iranian response. It was at least the second ADNOC vessel attack in a week.

media.caption: Drone strikes hit two ADNOC tankers in the Strait of Hormuz; UAE blames Iran

title: Trump Says He'll Declare Strait of Hormuz US Territory After 'Defeating' Iran, Vows to 'Never Apologize' for War
detail: Speaking at a Long Island, New York rally for Nassau County GOP gubernatorial candidate Bruce Blakeman, President Trump said 'after we finish defeating Iran, which is being very badly defeated ... pretty soon I'll be declaring the Hormuz Strait a territory of the United States,' describing the naval blockade as 'a wall of steel' under which 'no ships get through unless we want them to.' Trump separately declared he would 'never apologize' for the war, telling the crowd 'I did the right thing' and that Americans paying more for gasoline was worth it 'so that a very evil country cannot have ... a nuclear weapon.' A senior White House official later said Trump had not discussed the territorial claim with his advisers and suggested the remark was not to be taken literally.

media.caption: Trump says he will declare the Strait of Hormuz a US territory

title: USS George Washington Headed to Middle East to Relieve USS Abraham Lincoln After Record 250+ Days Deployed
detail: A US official confirmed the USS George Washington (CVN-73) carrier strike group, which finished a port visit in Vietnam on Aug 5, is headed to the Middle East to relieve the USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72), in a swap the official said had been previously planned. Lincoln has been deployed more than 250 days since leaving San Diego last November and has gone roughly 200 consecutive days without a port call — a modern-day record for a US carrier — fueling Democratic lawmaker demands for answers about crew welfare after a sailor went overboard earlier in August. Trump separately said Lincoln's deployment was 'not nearly long enough.'

title: Canada Sanctions Five Iranian Officials Over Strait of Hormuz Blockade
detail: Canadian Foreign Affairs Minister Anita Anand announced sanctions on five Iranian officials — including a senior IRGC official, the head of Iran's parliamentary foreign policy and national security committee, a naval commander, and the chair of Iran's energy exporters union — for obstructing navigation rights in and around the Strait of Hormuz and undermining 'international peace, security and stability.' The sanctions freeze any Canadian assets the individuals hold and bar Canadians from dealing with them. Ottawa's notice cited roughly 1,500 vessels stranded in the Persian Gulf as of Aug 6.
